title: Queue task lifecycle
lede: The states a queue task passes through, from the owner's request to a merged PR.

add.name: Add
add.role: The owner asks for work and the agent records it with the owner's words.
details: queue add --requested stores the owner's words with a title, an accept note and a validate command.
queue.db is the store; queue.md is its committed, readable view, re-rendered on each change.

pending.name: Pending
pending.role: The task waits its turn; the top eligible line runs first.

more: Eligible: its deps are done and it is not held.
Waiting: a dep or gate is unfinished.
Held: parked; the drain skips it until unheld.

active.name: Active
active.role: A worker or slot claims the task and a lease clock starts.
details: A tick or claim --worker sets the task's owner to the worker or slot.
release, or park --resume, returns it to pending.
risks: The lease is the age of the claim, not a process id; tick never reclaims an expired lease, it stops and reports.

outcome.name: Outcome
outcome.role: The task's validate command decides done, retry or failed.
details: A failure below maxFailures goes back to pending for a retry.
At maxFailures it is marked failed and stays visible; requeue revives it.
A done task auto-archives to archive.md, but stays while unfinished work depends on it.

deliver.name: Deliver
deliver.role: In per-task mode, the task's PR must merge before the queue moves on.
details: PR, real checks, and the owner approves the merge.
Then a fresh branch and queue advance --pr --branch.
risks: tick exits 7 until the task is advanced; that means delivery is pending, not that the queue drained.
qs: Why does a done task still hold up the queue until its PR merges?

lease.d: How long a claim has been held; not a process id.

gate.d: A task every other task depends on, used to block work temporarily.

maxfail.d: The retry cap before a task fails for good.

advance.d: Records the merged PR and the fresh branch so the queue moves on.

ask.context: The reader wants to understand how a task moves through scaffold's work queue, from request to merged PR.
